name: KDR Wood Design Co.
old_description: KDR Wood Design Co is a custom woodworking company based in Green Lake, WI. We specialize in creating high-quality, custom-made cabinetry, millwork, and furniture for any home or business. Our team of experienced carpenters and designers have the skill and artistry to create pieces that are both beautiful and functional.
about:
KDR Wood Design Co. is a custom woodworking company based in Green Lake, Wisconsin. The shop was founded by Kaleb (last name not disclosed) and operates as a full-service woodworking business serving both residential and commercial clients.

The company produces custom cabinetry, furniture, countertops, millwork, mantles, and shelves. It handles projects of any scale, from house additions to kitchen remodels, and uses high-quality wood and materials. In addition to fabrication, KDR provides project management services to keep jobs on schedule and on budget.

Clients include homeowners and businesses in the Green Lake area and beyond. Recent projects have included a garden work room cabinetry, a large custom bookcase, a master bath breakfront, and various built-to-order pieces for a lake home. The firm also works on kitchen redesigns and other finish carpentry needs.

KDR emphasizes vast experience, a professional team, high-quality finishes, and sustainable and accountable practices. Testimonials highlight the company's communication, coordination, craftsmanship, and ability to meet deadlines.
